lines.beaver: 어서 와요. 오늘은 진로 이야기를 해 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Come in. Shall we talk about your career path today?
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo wayo. oneureun jillo iyagireul hae bolkkayo?
lines.learner: 네, 선생님. 진로 때문에 앞이 캄캄해요.
lines.en: Yes, teacher. My future looks dark because of my career path.
lines.roman: ne, seonsaengnim. jillo ttaemune api kamkamhaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why all of a sudden? You had a dream.
lines.en: Originally, my dream was a job called judge.

lines.beaver_en: That's a good dream. Do you think differently now?
lines.en: Yes, these days I've become interested in master craftsmen.

lines.beaver_en: A craftsman? What kind of work do you want to do?
lines.learner: 나무로 가구를 만드는 장인이 되고 싶어요.
lines.en: I want to be a craftsman who makes wooden furniture.
lines.roman: namuro gagureul mandeuneun jangini doego sipeoyo.

lines.en: I learn every weekend at a place called a workshop.

lines.beaver: 퍽 열심히 하네요. 그래도 취업도 생각해야지요.
lines.beaver_en: You're working quite hard. But you should think about a job too.
lines.beaver_roman: peok yeolssimi haneyo. geuraedo chwieopdo saenggakaeyajiyo.
lines.en: Yes, I want to get a job at a furniture company.

lines.beaver_en: What kind of talent does that company want?
lines.en: They say they want talented people who are good with their hands.

lines.beaver: 그럼 공방 선생님께 추천서를 부탁해 봐요.
lines.beaver_en: Then try asking your workshop teacher for a recommendation letter.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom gongbang seonsaengnimkke chucheonseoreul butakae bwayo.
lines.en: Oh, there's a way called a recommendation letter!

lines.beaver: 다음 주에 직업과 진로에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we talk more about jobs and your career next week?
lines.beaver_roman: daeum jue jigeopgwa jilloe daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Yes, sounds good. I'll write a plan and bring it.
Thank you. Now I can see my way a little.
